trust_decision.summary: Whether a git invocation may write config keys that name an executable (here trailer.<token>.cmd / .command) without the allowUnsafeCommandBinaries opt-in; decided by a key-regex deny list in argv-parser, enforced by simple-git's spawn.args plugin.

landing_point.why: The summary names the unsafe-operation config guard; the tar.command allowUnsafeCommandBinaries entry is the obvious template to copy for trailer commands.

fix_sites.entry_point: simple-git raw('config', key, value), addConfig(), raw('-c', 'k=v', ...), --config-env, GIT_CONFIG_KEY_n env via simpleGit().env(); all go through vulnerabilityCheck
simple-git rebase([...'-x'|'--exec']) / raw('rebase', ...) — belongs to the bundled sibling advisory (rebase exec), not this one
same rebase entry points; flag spec so -qx clusters parse — bundled sibling advisory

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The trailer part of the fix is one list entry pair; all write routes (-c/--config, --config-env, git config, GIT_CONFIG_KEY_n) already funnel into the same ParsedConfigActivity.write list: packages/argv-parser/src/config/analyse-config.ts:52-85, packages/argv-parser/src/env/parse-env.ts:31-41,70-79

O3_reason_to_dismiss: For rename-section the checked key is the old section name and the new name is only the 'value', so a solver can argue a section rename is not 'configuring' a trailer command and that the source key was already allowed.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Other trailer.* settings (trailer.<token>.key, .where, .ifexists, trailer.separators) and interpretTrailers() parsing must keep working; blocking all trailer.* or the interpret-trailers task is over-broad.

O6_input_shapes: case/whitespace variants via key lowercasing+trim in producers (packages/argv-parser/src/config/analyse-config.ts:14, packages/argv-parser/src/env/parse-env.ts:38)

O7_producer.where: packages/argv-parser/src/config/detect-config-action.ts:42-62 (configOperation/toOperation map positionals to key/value; rename-section new name goes to value)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: git config --rename-section / rename-section verb: the new section name (e.g. renaming an allowed section into trailer.<token>) lands in value and is never matched; only config.key is tested
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Rename is a section operation, not a key write; pre-existing for every deny-list key, not trailer-specific; existing test asserts key=old name (packages/argv-parser/test/parse-config-write.spec.ts:55-56).
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the deny list; producer in packages/argv-parser/src/config/detect-config-action.ts and config-operands.ts:6,29

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Other executable-naming config keys absent from the list (e.g. sendemail/credential-style program or command keys) could be omitted in our copy the same way trailer was.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The list is hand-maintained per key; trailer was missed exactly this way.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Copy/rename-type config operations where the destination name is carried in value rather than key.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Mapper treats every write as key+value; maintainers wrote rename-section as key=old (test pins it).

O9_family: OS command injection via incomplete deny list of executable-naming git config keys (CWE-184/CWE-78)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add preventExpandedConfigBuilder('trailer.command', ...) only, missing the .cmd alias and the rename-section destination.

out_of_scope_notes: Fix commit bundles a separate advisory (rebase -x/--exec under allowUnsafeExec); its sites are listed but not screened.
Deny-list regexes are unanchored with unescaped '.' (detect-vulnerable-config-writes.ts:22,35), so they over-match arbitrary keys containing the pattern; not pursued.
unverified: repo_mb not measured; git-js is a small library and may meet tiny_repo, not asserted.

single_site flagged because the trailer fix is one list in one function; the rename-section O8 route is generic to every key, so a reviewer may decide it does not count as an advisory-specific uncovered route — if it counts, drop single_site.
Whether git interpret-trailers actually honours trailer.cmd without a subsection was not checked.
